SPIRELINGO-TRANSLATION_SECTION.title: Translation
SPIRELINGO-TARGET_LANGUAGE.title: Target language
SPIRELINGO-TARGET_LANGUAGE.hover.desc: The language shown in the extra tooltip. Restart the game after changing it.
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_SECTION.title: Show translation on
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_CARDS.title: Cards
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_CARDS.hover.desc: Adds a tooltip with the card's name and text in the target language.
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_RELICS.title: Relics
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_RELICS.hover.desc: Adds a tooltip with the relic's name and text in the target language.
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_POTIONS.title: Potions
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_POTIONS.hover.desc: Adds a tooltip with the potion's name and text in the target language.
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_POWERS.title: Powers
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_POWERS.hover.desc: Adds a tooltip with the power's name and text in the target language.
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_INTENTS.title: Enemy intents
SPIRELINGO-SHOW_ON_INTENTS.hover.desc: Adds a tooltip with the enemy intent's name and text in the target language.
SPIRELINGO-DISCOVERY_SECTION.title: Discovery mode
SPIRELINGO-DISCOVERY_KEY.title: Discovery key
SPIRELINGO-DISCOVERY_KEY.hover.desc: Press this key to turn discovery mode on or off. While it is on, the game is paused for input and you can click any word to look it up. Esc also leaves. F2 is not offered because the game uses it for feedback; some other F-keys are debug keys in developer builds.
SPIRELINGO-DISCOVERY_DIM.title: Discovery dimming
SPIRELINGO-DISCOVERY_DIM.hover.desc: How much the screen darkens while discovery mode is on, so it is clear the game is not taking clicks. 0 turns it off.
